comparison.objective: Seat an add-on circuit board over two rows of header pins without bending them; candidate replaces a motion-control harness connector.
comparison.physical_skill: Both require fine multi-contact alignment and controlled electrical mating; the PR uses parallel board-to-header insertion, while the candidate additionally claims unlatching, extraction, cable, and seal handling.
comparison.success_condition: PR measures board height, two-axis tilt, pin-bend history, release, and stability; candidate does not identify connector geometry, pins, latch, insertion depth, or damage/seal tests.
comparison.reason: The core tested ability may reduce to alignment and controlled electrical mating, and the candidate lacks enough geometry or rubric to establish a meaningful distinction.
